# A grid value menu's Clear drops focus to the page, so Escape no longer closes it

## Context

Found while stress-testing the grid shard for #19515, on `dev` `d0f92ff6a6`. `grid/IssuesShowcase.spec` "a filtered locked column keeps its header marked while its menu is closed (#19793)" failed 2 of 3 runs with the whole engine grid shard on 10 workers, and 1 of 20 run alone on 10 workers. Every failure was at the same line: after the menu's **Clear** and an Escape, `.neo-grid-column-menu` stayed visible for the full 5 s.

A probe made it deterministic. It is the same steps on `examples/grid/issues`, but it waits until the Clear button has left the DOM before pressing Escape, as a human's pause does. It failed 3/3 without load:

| moment | `document.activeElement` | menu |
|---|---|---|
| right after the Clear click | `BUTTON#neo-button-9` (the Clear button) | open |
| after the Clear button left the DOM | `BODY` | open |
| after Escape | `BODY` | **still open** (5 s) |

The spec only passes when Playwright's Escape outruns the button's removal.

## The Problem

Clearing the column's value filter hides the Clear button, which has nothing left to clear. The button is focused when it hides, so focus falls to the page:
- Escape no longer reaches the menu.
- A keyboard user who tabbed to Clear and pressed Enter loses their place.

The menu stays open until a click outside it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs`:
  - `onClearClick` calls `onSelectionChange({selection: []})`, and `refreshOptions()` then runs `clear.hidden = !selected.length; clear.update()`.
  - The surface's Escape handling needs focus inside the surface.
  - `open()` puts focus on the search field: `Neo.main.DomAccess.focus({id: surface.getItem('search').getInputElId(), unlessFocusWithin: surface.id, …})`.
- `clear.hidden = true` plus `clear.update()` is also the producer #20043 found (a component whose own flight renders it away). That ticket's fix keeps the flags paired; it does not move focus.

## The Fix

When a Clear click empties the selection, `onClearClick` moves focus to the search field before the button hides, the target `open()` uses. A red-first arm in `IssuesShowcase.spec` covers this: open the State menu, pick a value, Clear, wait for the Clear button to leave, then press Escape.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: after Clear, with the Clear button gone, focus sits inside the menu (on its search field) and Escape closes the menu. The arm is red on `d0f92ff6a6` and green at head.
- [ ] AC-2: the existing `IssuesShowcase.spec` arms stay green, and the #19793 arm passes 20/20 alone on 10 workers.

## Out of Scope

- A generic focus-on-removal rule for any focused component that hides itself. Worth a separate look; the menu case is the user-visible one.
- #20043's lifecycle pairing.
